quotations.old_english: Ðiós eorþe mæg and égorstreám cræfta náne adwæscan ðæt ðæt him on innan sticaþ
quotations.english: this earth and sea can by no means extinguish that which in them remains

source_text: égor-streám, eágor-streám, es; m. A water-stream, water, the sea; unda, fl&u-short;vius, m&a-short;re :-- Ðiós eorþe mæg and égorstreám cræfta náne adwæscan ðæt ðæt him on innan sticaþ this earth and sea can by no means extinguish that which in them remains. Bt. Met. Fox 20, 236; Met. 20, 118. Égorstreámas swógan the water-streams sounded, Cd. 69 ; Th. 83, 4; Gen. 1374.
